nodes.label: Content/Visibility Split Trap
nodes.summary: Ebda Store separates content existence (store_faqs, store_howtos, store_pages tables) from navigation visibility (Store.settings.footerLinks flags). Any automated path that writes content rows without flipping the matching footerLinks flag leaves content silently unreachable from the storefront nav.

nodes.label: ensureFooterSupportLinkEnabled helper
nodes.summary: Idempotent TypeScript helper in bulk-ai-aeo.ts that upserts a footerLinks.support entry to enabled:true after a bulk-AI sweep writes content rows. Handles both 'exists but disabled' and 'missing entirely' cases; try/catch wraps all DB access so a settings failure never blocks the parent write.

nodes.label: Co-write Visibility Flag on Content Creation
nodes.summary: Any code path that creates user-visible tenant content MUST also update the matching footerLinks visibility flag in the same operation. Applies to all automated writers: Inngest bulk-AI sweeps, migration scripts, seed scripts, and any future content-import paths.

nodes.label: Content Table → Footer href Mapping
nodes.summary: Lookup table mapping Ebda Store content tables to their canonical footer hrefs and default enabled state: store_faqs→/faq (usually false), store_howtos→/how-to-guides (often missing), store_pages→matches slug. Reviews and storeTestimonials have no footer link.
